items.question: How much does it cost to replace a lost Orrowind Drift earbud?
items.answer: Orrowind will replace one lost Drift earbud for a flat fee of $29 if the earbuds were registered in the Orrowind app within 60 days of purchase.

sources.title: Orrowind Help - Pairing Drift earbuds with a new phone
sources.text:
Orrowind Drift earbuds can remember up to four devices, but they stay connected to only one at a time. To pair them with a new phone or tablet, put both earbuds in the charging case and leave the lid open. Press and hold the button on the back of the case for three seconds until the status light flashes blue. Then open Bluetooth settings on your phone and choose Orrowind Drift from the list of available devices.

If you already use the Orrowind app, sign in on the new phone with the same account. Your equaliser presets and touch controls appear as soon as the earbuds connect. You do not need to unpair the earbuds from your old phone first, although doing so stops them from reconnecting to it when both phones are nearby.

Switching between remembered devices
Drift earbuds reconnect to the last device they were used with. To switch, open Bluetooth settings on the device you want to use and tap Orrowind Drift. The earbuds drop the previous connection within a few seconds.

Troubleshooting
If the status light flashes red instead of blue, the case is low on charge. Charge it for at least 15 minutes and try again. If pairing still fails, reset the earbuds by holding the case button for 15 seconds until the light flashes white three times, then pair them as a new device.

sources.title: Orrowind Help - Lost a Drift earbud?
sources.text:
Losing one earbud is the most common request our support team receives, so try Drift Locator before you order anything. Open the Orrowind app, tap your earbuds, then tap Locate. If the missing earbud is within Bluetooth range, it plays a rising chirp for up to two minutes. The map below the Locate button shows where the earbud was last connected to your phone.

Ordering a replacement earbud
Orrowind will replace one lost Drift earbud for a flat fee of $29 if the earbuds were registered in the Orrowind app within 60 days of purchase. To place an order, go to Support in the app, choose Lost earbud, and say whether the left or right earbud is missing. You will need the serial number printed inside the lid of your charging case.

Replacement earbuds ship within three business days and arrive already updated to the latest firmware. When yours arrives, put both earbuds in the case, close the lid for ten seconds, then open it and hold the case button until the light flashes white. The new earbud pairs with the one you still have, and your app settings carry over automatically.

If you have lost the charging case rather than an earbud, see the separate article on replacing a charging case.

sources.title: Orrowind Help - Battery life and charging case care
sources.text:
Drift earbuds play for up to seven hours on a single charge with noise cancelling switched off, or up to five hours with it switched on. A fully charged case holds about three more full charges, and ten minutes in the case gives roughly an hour of listening.

Charging the case
Use the USB-C cable that came in the box with any USB charger rated at 5 volts. The case also charges on any Qi-certified wireless pad. The light on the front of the case shows green when it has more than half its charge, amber when it is between a quarter and a half, and red when it needs charging soon.

Looking after the battery
Lithium-ion batteries last longest when they are kept away from heat. Avoid leaving the case on a sunny windowsill or in a parked car on a hot day. If you will not use your earbuds for several weeks, charge the case to about half and store it somewhere cool and dry.

Battery health in the app
The Orrowind app shows an estimate of battery health for each earbud and for the case under Settings, then Battery. A gradual decline over two or three years of daily use is normal.

items.question: Can I get a refund on my Lyrabeck subscription?
items.answer: Lyrabeck refunds an annual Premium subscription in full if you request the refund within 14 days of the purchase date.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Downloading lessons for offline use
sources.text:
With Lyrabeck Premium you can download lessons and practise without an internet connection, which is handy on flights, in the underground or anywhere with patchy signal.

How to download
Open a course, tap the unit you want, then tap the download arrow next to the unit title. You can download a whole unit at once or individual lessons. Downloaded lessons show a small filled circle on the course map. Audio, images and the pronunciation coach's example recordings are all saved to your device.

Storage
A typical unit takes between 40 and 90 MB. To see how much space your downloads use, go to Settings, then Storage. You can delete a single unit by swiping left on it, or remove everything with Clear all downloads.

Keeping your progress in sync
Lessons you complete offline are saved on your device and uploaded to your account the next time you connect. If you study on more than one device, connect each one at least once a week so your streak and review schedule stay accurate across all of them. Speaking exercises completed offline are scored when you reconnect, so your score for those may appear a little later than usual.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Changing your course language
sources.text:
You can study more than one language on Lyrabeck, and you can switch between them whenever you like. Progress in each language is kept separately, so switching never resets anything.

Adding a new language
Tap the flag at the top of the Learn tab, then tap Add a language. Choose the language you want to learn and the language you want instructions in. Lyrabeck currently offers 18 courses taught from English and 9 taught from Spanish. A short placement quiz suggests where to start, or you can begin from the first unit.

Switching between languages
Tap the flag and choose the language you want to study today. Your daily goal applies to all your languages combined, so a lesson in any of them counts towards your streak.

Removing a language
If you no longer want a course, tap the flag, then Edit, then the minus sign next to the language. Removing a course hides it from your list but does not delete your progress. If you add the same course again later, you will return to the unit you reached.

sources.title: Lyrabeck Help - Refunds
sources.text:
Lyrabeck Premium unlocks every course, the pronunciation coach and offline lessons. You can pay for Premium monthly or annually, and you can cancel at any time from Account, then Subscription.

Asking for a refund
Lyrabeck refunds an annual Premium subscription in full if you request the refund within 14 days of the purchase date. To ask for one, open Account, then Billing, and tap Request a refund next to the payment. We will ask you for a reason, but your answer does not affect the decision. You will receive an email confirming the refund, usually within one business day.

Where the money goes
Refunds are returned to the card or digital wallet you paid with. Most banks show the money in your account within five to ten business days, although some take longer around public holidays. If the card you used has since expired or been cancelled, your bank will normally pass the refund to your new card or account automatically.

What happens to your progress
Once a refund is issued, your account moves to the free plan straight away. Your streaks, course progress and saved vocabulary lists are kept, so you can pick up where you left off if you subscribe again later. Lessons you downloaded for offline use are removed from your devices the next time the app connects to the internet.

items.question: How much paid parental leave does Harrowmede Logistics give employees?
items.answer: Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave if they have completed 12 months of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.2 Parental leave
sources.text:
Harrowmede Logistics supports employees who are welcoming a child through birth, adoption or surrogacy. This section explains how much leave is available, how to request it, and what continues while you are away.

How much leave you can take
Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave if they have completed 12 months of continuous service by the expected date of birth or placement. You can take parental leave in one block or in up to three separate blocks, as long as all of it is used before the child's first birthday or the first anniversary of the placement. If both parents work for Harrowmede, they may take leave at the same time.

Requesting leave
Tell your line manager and the People team in writing at least eight weeks before you want your leave to start. Use the Parental Leave form on the People Hub and attach the expected due date, or the placement date confirmed by your adoption or surrogacy agency. If the date changes, update the form as soon as you can.

While you are away
Your pension contributions, life cover and private medical insurance continue during parental leave, and you keep accruing annual leave at your normal rate. You may work up to ten Keeping in Touch days, paid at your normal daily rate, without bringing your leave to an end. Your manager will agree with you in advance how you would like to be contacted.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.1 Annual leave
sources.text:
Full-time employees at Harrowmede Logistics receive 25 days of paid annual leave each holiday year, plus public holidays. The holiday year runs from 1 January to 31 December. Part-time employees receive a pro rata entitlement based on their contracted hours, which the People team calculates and shows on the People Hub.

Booking leave
Request leave through the People Hub at least two weeks before the first day you want off. Your line manager will approve or decline within five working days. During peak season, from mid-November to the end of December, depot and warehouse teams may have limits on how many people can be away at once, so book early.

Carrying leave over
You can carry up to five unused days into the next holiday year. Carried-over days must be used by 31 March or they are lost. If you could not take leave because of sickness or family leave, speak to the People team, as different carry-over rules may apply.

Leaving Harrowmede
If you leave part way through the year, you will be paid for any leave you have accrued but not taken. If you have taken more leave than you have accrued, the difference is deducted from your final pay.

sources.title: Harrowmede Employee Handbook - 7.4 Bereavement leave
sources.text:
Losing someone close is hard, and work should be the last thing on your mind. Harrowmede gives employees time away to grieve, make arrangements and attend a funeral or memorial.

How much leave
You can take up to ten working days of paid bereavement leave following the death of a partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent or grandchild, or anyone you lived with as part of your household. For the death of another relative or a close friend, you can take up to three working days of paid leave. The days do not need to be taken together, and you can use some of them later, for example to attend a memorial service or to deal with the estate.

Pregnancy loss
If you or your partner experience a miscarriage or stillbirth at any stage of pregnancy, you can take up to ten working days of paid leave.

How to request it
Let your line manager know as soon as you feel able to, by phone, message or email. You do not need to provide a death certificate or any other evidence. If your manager is not available, contact the People team directly, who will make sure your shifts or deliveries are covered.

items.question: Will Kestrova Studios pay for a course I want to take?
items.answer: Kestrova reimburses tuition for an approved course up to $5,250 per calendar year if you complete the course with a passing grade.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Conference attendance
sources.text:
Industry events are a great way to see new work, meet other studios and bring fresh ideas back to your team. Each team at Kestrova has a conference budget, set at the start of the financial year, which the team lead manages.

Asking to attend
Talk to your team lead about the event, what you hope to learn, and how it fits with current project deadlines. If they agree, they will book your ticket through the studio's events account so that you do not have to pay anything up front. Travel and hotels are booked through the travel desk in the usual way.

Speaking at an event
If you have been invited to speak or to show your work, let the Communications team know at least four weeks before the event. They can help with slides, check that any client work you plan to show has been cleared for public use, and promote your session on Kestrova's channels.

Sharing what you learned
Within two weeks of returning, share a short write-up or a ten-minute talk with your team. Most people choose to present at the Friday studio show-and-tell. Write-ups are saved to the Learning library so that colleagues who could not attend can benefit too.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Tuition assistance
sources.text:
Kestrova Studios wants everyone to keep building their skills, whether that means a short certificate in motion graphics or a part-time degree. The tuition assistance programme helps with the cost.

What is covered
Kestrova reimburses tuition for an approved course up to $5,250 per calendar year if you complete the course with a passing grade. A course is approved when it relates to your current role, or to a role you could reasonably move into at Kestrova, and it is offered by an accredited college, university or recognised professional body. Tuition and mandatory course fees count towards the annual amount. Textbooks, software licences and travel do not.

How to apply
Submit a Tuition Request in the People portal at least 30 days before the course begins. Your manager reviews the request first, then the Learning team checks the course against the approval criteria. You will usually receive a decision by email within ten working days.

Claiming your reimbursement
When the course ends, upload your receipts and your final grade report or certificate to the same Tuition Request. The Learning team checks the documents, and the reimbursement is added to the next monthly pay run. Reimbursements are paid in US dollars; if you paid in another currency, the exchange rate on the day the Learning team approves the claim is used.

sources.title: Kestrova Studios Handbook - Mentoring programme
sources.text:
The Kestrova mentoring programme pairs people who want to grow in a particular direction with experienced colleagues from a different team. Mentoring is voluntary, and it sits alongside the support you get from your manager rather than replacing it.

Joining as a mentee
Sign-ups open twice a year, in March and September. Fill in the short form on the People portal describing what you would like help with, such as moving into art direction, building client confidence or learning a new tool. The Learning team matches you with a mentor within three weeks.

Becoming a mentor
Anyone who has been at Kestrova for at least two years can volunteer as a mentor. Mentors attend a two-hour introductory workshop and are encouraged to meet their mentee at least once a month for six months.

Ending a mentoring pair
Either person can end the arrangement at any time by letting the Learning team know. There is no need to give a reason. If a pairing is not working, the Learning team will happily find you a different match.

sources.title: Halvorn Help - Setting up multi-room audio

If you have more than one Halvorn speaker, you can group them so the same music plays in several rooms at once, perfectly in sync.

Creating a group
Open the Halvorn Home app and tap Rooms. Tap Create group, choose the speakers you want to include, and give the group a name such as Downstairs or Whole house. A speaker can belong to more than one group, but it can only play one stream at a time.

Playing music to a group
Say the wake phrase followed by the name of the song and the group, for example "play some jazz in Downstairs". In the app, choose the group as the output before you press play. Volume can be set for the whole group or for each speaker individually.

Tips for a stable connection
Every speaker in a group must be on the same Wi-Fi network. If music drops out on one speaker, move it closer to your router or add a mesh point. Groups work best with up to eight speakers. If a speaker has been unplugged, it rejoins its groups automatically when it reconnects.

sources.title: Halvorn Help - Voice profiles
sources.text:
Voice profiles let your Halvorn speaker recognise who is talking, so it can give each person in your home their own calendar, reminders and music recommendations.

Creating a voice profile
Open the Halvorn Home app, tap your account picture, then tap Voice profile. You will be asked to read six short phrases aloud in a quiet room. It takes about two minutes. Each person who wants a profile needs their own Halvorn account, and up to six profiles can be linked to one home.

What changes when a profile is set up
When the speaker recognises you, it reads your own calendar events and reminders and plays from your music library and playlists. If it does not recognise the voice, it answers general questions but will not read out personal information.

Removing a profile
Go to the same Voice profile screen and tap Delete profile. Your voice data is deleted from Halvorn's servers within 30 days. Removing a profile does not delete your Halvorn account or your music library.

items.question: How many people can share a Fenwhistle budget?
items.answer: On the Family plan, up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Sharing a budget
sources.text:
A shared budget lets you plan spending with other people, split household bills and work towards the same goals, while everyone sees the same categories and balances.

Who can share
On the Family plan, up to six people can share one Fenwhistle budget. Each person signs in with their own Fenwhistle account, so their personal budgets, linked bank accounts and login details stay private. Only the categories, goals and transactions added to the shared budget are visible to everyone in it.

Inviting someone
Open the budget, tap Members, then tap Invite and enter the other person's email address. The invitation stays valid for seven days. If they do not have a Fenwhistle account yet, the invitation walks them through creating one.

Roles
The person who created the shared budget is its owner. The owner can rename the budget, remove members and delete the budget. Other members can add transactions, edit categories and set goals, but they cannot remove anyone else.

Leaving a shared budget
Any member can leave at any time from Members, then Leave budget. Transactions they added stay in the shared budget so the history remains complete.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Connecting a bank account
sources.text:
Linking a bank account lets Fenwhistle import your transactions automatically, so you spend less time typing and more time planning.

How to connect
Open Accounts, tap Add account, then search for your bank. You will be sent to your bank's own sign-in page to approve read-only access. Fenwhistle never sees or stores your online banking password, and it cannot move money in or out of your accounts.

How often transactions update
New transactions usually appear within a few hours of clearing at your bank. Pending card payments are shown in grey until they clear. You can pull the account list down to request a refresh at any time.

Renewing access
For security, banks ask you to renew Fenwhistle's access every 90 days. Fenwhistle reminds you a week before access expires. If it does expire, your past transactions stay in Fenwhistle, but new ones stop importing until you reconnect.

Disconnecting
Tap the account, then Settings, then Disconnect. You can keep the imported transactions as a manual account or delete them along with the connection.

sources.title: Fenwhistle Help - Setting savings goals
sources.text:
Goals help you put money aside for something specific, such as a holiday, a new laptop or an emergency fund, and track how close you are.

Creating a goal
Tap Goals, then New goal. Give it a name, a target amount and, if you like, a target date. Fenwhistle works out how much you would need to set aside each month to reach the target on time and shows it as a suggested monthly amount.

Funding a goal
Each time you get paid, Fenwhistle asks whether you want to move the suggested amount into your goals. Fenwhistle does not move real money between your bank accounts; goals are a way of earmarking part of your balance, so the amount in a goal is subtracted from what the app shows as available to spend.

Changing or finishing a goal
You can change the target, the date or the name at any time. When a goal reaches its target, Fenwhistle shows a short celebration and asks whether you want to archive the goal or keep adding to it. Archived goals stay in your history so you can see what you have achieved.

items.question: How many days a week can I work from home at Corrimant Health?
items.answer: Employees based in the Dublin and Lisbon offices can work remotely for up to three days per week.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.1 Core hours and flexitime
sources.text:
Corrimant Health operates a flexitime system so that you can fit your working day around the rest of your life, within some shared limits.

Core hours
Core hours are 10 a.m. to 12 noon and 2 p.m. to 4 p.m., Monday to Friday. Unless you are on agreed leave, you should be available during core hours for meetings and calls. Outside core hours you can choose when to start and finish, between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m.

Recording your time
Full-time employees work 37.5 hours a week. Record your start and finish times in the Workplace app each day. If you work more than your contracted hours, you can carry up to 15 hours of credit into the next month, and you can use credit to take up to two flexi days off in any month, with your manager's agreement.

Shift-based roles
Some roles, such as those in our clinical support centre, work set shifts rather than flexitime. If you are on a shift pattern, your rota is published in the Workplace app at least four weeks ahead, and swaps must be approved by your shift lead.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.3 Hybrid working
sources.text:
Corrimant Health believes most teams do their best work with a mix of time together in the office and focused time at home. This section explains how hybrid working operates and what we ask of everyone who uses it.

Remote days
Employees based in the Dublin and Lisbon offices can work remotely for up to three days per week. Agree your remote days with your manager and record them in the Workplace app, so that desk booking and fire-safety rosters stay accurate. Your pattern can change from week to week, as long as your manager agrees in advance.

Team days
Each team chooses one anchor day a week when everyone comes in. Anchor days are used for planning, reviews and the kind of conversations that are easier in person. Please avoid booking leave on your team's anchor day where you can.

Your home workspace
You need a quiet place to work, a reliable internet connection and a space where you can take confidential calls without being overheard, because many of our teams discuss patient data. The IT team will send you a laptop, a headset and a monitor on request. Complete the home workspace safety checklist on the People portal before your first remote day, and repeat it if you move house.

sources.title: Corrimant Health Employee Handbook - 4.4 Booking a desk
sources.text:
Our offices use shared desks, so you need to book one through the Workplace app for each day you plan to come in.

Booking
Desks can be booked up to two weeks ahead. Choose the floor and the neighbourhood where your team usually sits, then pick a desk from the map. Bookings for your team's anchor day open a day earlier than other days so that teams can sit together.

Checking in
When you arrive, scan the QR code on the desk with the Workplace app. If you have not checked in by 10.30 a.m., the booking is released so that a colleague can use the desk.

Lockers and storage
Lockers are available on every floor for anything you want to leave in the office overnight. Lockers are allocated for three months at a time; request one from the facilities team in the app. Please clear your desk at the end of each day, because the cleaning team needs clear surfaces.

Accessibility
If you need a particular desk set-up, such as a sit-stand desk, a specific chair or a quieter area, tell the facilities team. They can reserve a suitable desk for you on a permanent basis.

items.question: Does Quorrel Foods give employees money towards their phone bill?
items.answer: Employees in the Sales and Customer Success departments receive a monthly mobile phone stipend of $60.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Company vehicles
sources.text:
Some roles at Quorrel come with a company vehicle, either a car for travelling between customer sites or a van for deliveries and merchandising. Your offer letter tells you whether your role includes one.

Before you drive
You must hold a full driving licence valid in the country where you will drive, and you must have shown the original to the fleet team. The fleet team checks licences every six months. Tell your manager straight away if you receive penalty points or a driving ban.

Fuel and charging
Each vehicle comes with a fuel or charging card. Use it only for the vehicle it belongs to. Private mileage in a company car is allowed, but it is recorded and may affect the tax you pay.

Accidents and breakdowns
If you are involved in an accident, make sure everyone is safe first, then call the 24-hour fleet helpline printed on the key fob. Do not admit liability at the scene. Report every accident, however minor, within 24 hours.

Looking after the vehicle
Keep the vehicle clean and book it in for servicing when the dashboard reminder appears.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Business travel
sources.text:
When you travel for Quorrel, book flights, trains and hotels through the travel portal so that we can find you quickly if something goes wrong while you are away.

Booking
Book at least 14 days ahead where you can. Economy class is standard for all flights. For journeys by train, standard class is the default, but first class can be booked if the journey is over three hours and you need to work on the way. Hotels should be within the nightly limits shown in the portal for each city.

Using your own car
If you drive your own car on business, claim mileage through the expenses system. Keep a note of the start and end points and the purpose of each trip. Mileage covers fuel and wear and tear, so you cannot claim fuel separately.

Meals
While travelling overnight, you can claim up to $55 a day for meals. Keep itemised receipts. Alcohol cannot be claimed.

Claiming expenses
Submit claims within 60 days of the expense. Claims approved by your manager are paid with your next salary payment.

sources.title: Quorrel Foods People Handbook - Mobile phones
sources.text:
Many colleagues rely on their own phones to stay in touch with stores, distributors and customers while they are out and about. This section explains how phone costs are handled and what we expect when you use your phone for work.

Phone stipend
Employees in the Sales and Customer Success departments receive a monthly mobile phone stipend of $60. The stipend is added to your salary payment on the last working day of each month and appears on your payslip as Mobile Allowance. It is treated as taxable income in the same way as your salary.

You choose your own handset, network and plan. Quorrel does not pay for the cost of buying a phone.

Using your phone for work
Install the Quorrel Workspace app before you access work email or chat on your phone. The app keeps work data in a separate, encrypted area, which the IT team can wipe remotely if your phone is lost or you leave Quorrel. IT cannot see your personal photos, messages or browsing.

Lost or stolen phones
Report a lost or stolen phone to the IT service desk straight away, at any time of day, so that work data can be removed.

items.question: Do I have to pay to book live classes on Mistlark?
items.answer: Mistlark members can book unlimited live classes at no charge during the first 30 days after creating their account.

sources.title: Mistlark Help - Pairing a heart-rate monitor
sources.text:
Pairing a heart-rate monitor lets Mistlark show your heart rate during workouts and live classes, and gives you more accurate calorie and training-load estimates.

Compatible monitors
Mistlark works with chest straps and armbands that use Bluetooth Low Energy and the standard heart-rate profile. Most monitors sold in the last five years are compatible. Smartwatches can also share heart rate if their own app allows broadcasting to other apps.

Pairing
Wear the monitor, then open Mistlark and go to Profile, then Devices, then Add device. Choose Heart-rate monitor and wait for yours to appear in the list. Tap it to pair. You only need to do this once; Mistlark reconnects automatically the next time you start a workout while wearing it.

During a workout
Your heart rate appears at the top right of the screen, colour-coded by zone. In live classes, you can choose whether to share your zone, but never your exact heart rate, on the class leaderboard.

Troubleshooting
If the reading drops out, moisten the chest strap's sensor pads and make sure the monitor is not paired to another app at the same time.

sources.title: Mistlark Help - Booking live classes
sources.text:
Live classes are streamed from the Mistlark studio throughout the day, from early-morning yoga to evening strength sessions. Every class has a live instructor and up to 40 participants, and you can choose whether your camera is on or off.

Booking a class
Open the Live tab to see the timetable for the next seven days. Tap a class to read a description, see the equipment you will need and check how many places are left, then tap Book. Mistlark members can book unlimited live classes at no charge during the first 30 days after creating their account. Your bookings appear under Live, then My classes, and Mistlark sends a reminder 15 minutes before each class starts.

Cancelling
To cancel, open My classes and tap Cancel booking. Please cancel at least two hours before the start so that someone on the waiting list can take your place.

Waiting lists
If a class is full, tap Join waiting list. When a place opens up, Mistlark books it for you automatically and sends a notification. You can be on the waiting list for up to three classes at once.

Joining
Classes open five minutes before the start time. Tap Join from the reminder or from My classes.

sources.title: Mistlark Help - Building a custom training plan
sources.text:
A custom training plan schedules on-demand workouts around your goals and the days you have free. You can change it at any time, and Mistlark adjusts the rest of the plan as you go.

Creating a plan
Go to Plan, then Create plan. Choose a goal, such as running your first 5K, building strength or improving mobility, and pick how many days a week you want to train. Mistlark builds a plan of four to twelve weeks using workouts from the on-demand library.

Adjusting your plan
If you miss a workout, Mistlark moves it to your next free day rather than skipping it. You can also swap any workout for a similar one by tapping it and choosing Swap. After every two weeks, Mistlark asks how the plan feels and makes the next fortnight easier or harder depending on your answers.

Finishing a plan
When you complete a plan, Mistlark shows a summary of your workouts, total minutes and progress against your goal. You can start a new plan straight away or repeat the same plan at a higher level.

items.question: How much is the employee referral bonus at Vellacourt Insurance?
items.answer: Vellacourt pays referring employees a $3,000 bonus for each referred hire who starts between 1 November 2026 and 28 February 2027.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Employee referral programme
sources.text:
Great colleagues often know other great people. Our referral programme thanks you for introducing candidates who go on to join Vellacourt Insurance.

Referral bonus
Vellacourt pays referring employees a $3,000 bonus for each referred hire who starts between 1 November 2026 and 28 February 2027. The bonus is added to your salary in the first payroll run after your referred colleague's start date and is taxed in the same way as your salary.

How to refer someone
Open the Careers page on the People Hub, find the role, and choose Refer a friend. Add the candidate's name, email address and CV, along with a few lines about why you think they would be a good fit. The candidate receives an email inviting them to complete their application. You can track the progress of each referral from the My referrals page, although interview feedback stays confidential.

Good practice
Only refer people you know and would be happy to work with. Ask the candidate before you share their details, and do not promise them an interview or an offer, because every referred candidate goes through the same selection process as other applicants. If you are on the interview panel for someone you referred, tell the Talent team so that they can arrange a replacement panel member.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Onboarding a new starter
sources.text:
A good first week makes a lasting difference. If someone is joining your team, these steps help them settle in quickly.

Before they arrive
The Talent team sends the new starter a welcome pack about two weeks before their first day. As their manager, add them to your team's calendar invitations and chat channels, and choose an onboarding buddy from the team. The IT team ships a laptop to their home address or leaves it at the reception of their office, depending on what they chose.

The first day
Plan to spend the first morning with your new starter. Introduce them to the team, walk them through the week's schedule and make sure they can sign in to their laptop and the People Hub. Vellacourt's company induction takes place on the first Tuesday of every month, and the Talent team books new starters onto the next available session.

The first 90 days
Agree three to five goals in the first two weeks and hold a short check-in each week. At 90 days, complete the probation review form on the People Hub together. Most probation periods end at 90 days, but they can be extended once by up to a further 90 days.

sources.title: Vellacourt People Hub - Interview panels
sources.text:
Every role at Vellacourt is filled through a structured interview, so that candidates are assessed fairly and on the same criteria.

Who sits on a panel
Each panel has two or three members: the hiring manager, a colleague from the team and, for senior roles, a member of the leadership group. At least one panel member must have completed the structured interviewing course in the last two years.

Preparing
The Talent team shares the interview questions and the scoring guide three days before the interview. Read the candidate's CV and application, but do not search for them on social media.

During the interview
Ask every candidate the same core questions, in the same order. You can ask follow-up questions to understand an answer better. Take notes as you go, focusing on what the candidate said and did rather than your impressions.

Scoring and feedback
Score each answer independently, before talking to the other panel members. Then meet as a panel to agree an overall decision. Submit scores and notes in the hiring system within 24 hours, so that the Talent team can give the candidate timely feedback.

items.answer: Between 4 June and 27 August 2027, Quillfen studios close at 1 p.m. on Fridays.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Annual leave
sources.text:
Everyone at Quillfen Architects receives 27 days of paid annual leave a year, plus public holidays, rising to 30 days after five years with the practice. The leave year runs from 1 April to 31 March.

Booking leave
Request leave in the HR system and copy in your project lead. Try to give at least four weeks' notice for anything longer than a week, and check the project calendar first so that you are not away during a planned submission or a key client presentation.

Sickness during leave
If you are ill during a period of annual leave, tell your line manager as soon as you can. Days of illness covered by a fit note can be reclaimed and taken as annual leave at another time.

Carrying over leave
Up to five days can be carried over into the next leave year with your project lead's agreement. Carried-over days must be used by 30 June.

Buying extra leave
Once a year, in March, you can buy up to five extra days of leave. The cost is spread across your salary payments for the following twelve months.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Professional registration and CPD
sources.text:
Quillfen supports architects, architectural assistants and technologists in gaining and keeping their professional registration.

Registration fees
The practice pays the annual registration fee and one professional institute membership for every member of staff who holds, or is working towards, a professional qualification. Submit the invoice to the finance team before the renewal date and they will pay it directly.

Continuing professional development
Registered architects must complete at least 35 hours of CPD each year. Quillfen runs a lunchtime CPD talk every other Wednesday, covering topics such as building regulations, fire safety, sustainable materials and contract law. Talks are recorded and saved to the learning library for anyone who cannot attend.

Study leave for qualifications
If you are studying for Part 2 or Part 3, you can take up to ten days of paid study leave a year for exams and submissions, in addition to annual leave. Agree the dates with your project lead as early as you can.

Keeping records
Log your CPD hours in the HR system. Your line manager reviews them with you at your mid-year conversation.

sources.title: Quillfen Staff Handbook - Summer Fridays
sources.text:
Summer Fridays give everyone at Quillfen time to enjoy the long evenings while the weather is good.

Between 4 June and 27 August 2027, Quillfen studios close at 1 p.m. on Fridays. The closed afternoons are paid and do not count against your annual leave.

Client commitments
Project deadlines, site visits and client meetings still come first. If a planning hearing, site inspection or client presentation is booked for a Friday afternoon during this period, your project lead will agree with you who needs to attend. Anyone who works a Friday afternoon during the period can take the same number of hours off on another day within four weeks, agreed with their project lead.

Part-time staff
If you do not normally work on Fridays, you can take an equivalent half day on another day in the same week, agreed with your project lead.

Getting into the building
The studio buildings are locked from 1.30 p.m. on these Fridays, and the alarm is set at 2 p.m. If you need to collect drawings or models after that time, ask the office manager in advance for an out-of-hours pass. Remote access to the project server and email is available as usual.
